reserveReview.rationale: SoulPeg documents SPUSD as a claim on soul-bound sUSDC, routed through a Venus USDC strategy on BSC using an 18-decimal USDC representation. The SPUSD overview identifies sUSDC 0x0e8fb2e774b827711e0f86069931c1321113238e. SPUSD asset() and underlying() reverted at BSC block 124853997 on 2026-09-30; sUSDC asset() and token() reverted at block 124854221. Earlier wrapper-layer coverage does not prove the underlying representation or its issuer escrow. The root USDC basket edge is withheld pending the exact sUSDC-to-vault-to-underlying identity join and independently verified bridge/custodian backing.
